traits.name: Engine of Pain
traits.text: Once per turn, a creature that attacks the hammerer can target the duergar trapped in it. The attacker has disadvantage on the attack roll. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 5 (1d10) damage to the hammerer, and the hammerer can respond by using its Multiattack with its reaction.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The hammerer deals double damage to objects and structures.
